event_records.description: The Springfield City Council meeting begins. The proposed 2027 budget is on the agenda for discussion and a vote.

springfield_city_council.name: Springfield City Council
springfield_city_council.persona_brief:
You are Springfield City Council.
The council is a group of elected officials who will meet to discuss and vote on the 2027 budget. Each member has their own views on the budget, but the council as a whole must decide by majority vote.

resolution.question: Does the Springfield City Council vote to approve the 2027 budget during the October 5, 2026 meeting?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the Springfield City Council voted to approve the 2027 budget during the October 5, 2026 meeting, before the meeting ends or the hard cutoff of 2026-10-05T23:59:00-05:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
